docs: Returns are accepted within 30 days of delivery. Items must be unused and in their original packaging.
Delivery inside Dhaka takes 1 to 2 days. Outside Dhaka it takes 3 to 5 days.
We accept bKash, Nagad and cash on delivery. Card payments are not available.
Our shop is open from 10 AM to 9 PM, Saturday to Thursday. Closed on Friday.
Saree blouse pieces can be tailored within 7 working days for an extra 300 taka.
Orders can be cancelled before they are shipped. After shipment, cancellation is not possible.
Exchange is available once for a different size of the same product within 7 days.
Gift wrapping costs 100 taka and is available for all products.
